test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Where were the 35th National Games held in the year 2015?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kerala** hosted the National Games for the **second time**, the first being in **1987.**
 
• The **35th National Games** were held from** 31st January to 14th February 2015.**
 
• Over **12,000 athletes **from **36 states** and union territories participated in** 33 sports disciplines.**
 
• Kerala emerged as the **overall champions** with a total of** 162 medals, **including 54 gold, 48 silver, and 60 bronze medals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Goa** hosted the **37th** National Games in the year **2023.**
 
• **Mumbai**, formerly known as Bombay**, hosted** the National Games of India in **1940.**
 
• **Punjab** hosted the **31st** National Games in the year** 2001.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The National Games aimed to identify sporting talent who could represent the country at the Olympics.
 
• After the 1920 Olympics, it was suggested that a national-level body to promote Olympic sports and after a meeting of the selection committee for the Olympics, the All India Olympic Committee was set up.
 
• The committee organized the** first National Games in 1924 in Lahore** - now in Pakistan - in what was then undivided India. It was then called the ‘All India Olympic Games’.
 
• The All India Olympic Committee eventually transitioned into the **Indian** **Olympic Association (IOA) in 1927** with Dorabji Tata as president and Dr Noehren, the secretary.
